about: Third-year Automation and Robotics Engineering student at JAMK University of Applied Sciences, with 153 of 240 credits completed and an estimated graduation in 2028. Studies include control systems, measurement technology, electrical engineering, electronics, functional safety, deep learning and robotics. Hands-on background includes C programming, PLC logic, building automation systems monitoring and industrial machine fabrication. Holds SFS 60002 electrical safety training (valid on JAMK premises; card pending) and an Occupational Safety Card, and has completed 12 credits of official practical training. Seeking an entry-level or trainee position in Finland in automation, electrical engineering, robotics or control systems.
